facts.claim: approvals.mode smart|manual|off, default smart; approvals.deny globs enforced before --yolo; hardline blocklist cannot be overridden.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: SECURITY.md: approval gate is a heuristic over shell strings, 'not a boundary'.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D01.rationale: Approval gate with smart (LLM-assisted) default, manual and off modes, glob deny list enforced before yolo, hardline blocklist, allowlist; but the project itself says the gate is a heuristic, and smart mode lets an auxiliary LLM auto-approve.

facts.claim: Default terminal backend runs commands directly on the host; non-default backends confine only shell/file tools.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: CVE-2026-9368: sandbox issue in execute_code env handler (< 0.11.0).
facts.label: third-party-report

D02.rationale: Default terminal backend runs commands on the host; Docker/SSH/cloud backends and whole-process wrapping are opt-in; official docs say sandboxes do not confine in-process code (execute_code, MCP, plugins, hooks).

facts.claim: iron-proxy wired into Docker backend only; sandbox holds opaque proxy tokens, upstream host allowlist in proxy.yaml.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Default Docker network_mode: host gives unrestricted outbound access.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D03.rationale: Egress controls are opt-in: iron-proxy credential-injection proxy (Docker backend only) and Docker network segmentation guide; default is unrestricted.

facts.claim: Project-local plugins under ./.hermes/plugins/ are disabled by default; enable with HERMES_ENABLE_PROJECT_PLUGINS=true.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Shell-hook consent is first-use per (event, command); allowlist keys on command string so script edits are silently trusted.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: CVE-2026-9366: _scan_context_content injection bypass (< 0.15.0); CVE-2026-9369: project-plugin env comparison flaw (< 0.15.0).
facts.label: third-party-report

D04.rationale: Project plugins disabled by default (env opt-in), shell hooks need per-(event,command) consent, MCP trust prompts; context files load without trust prompt but are injection-scanned (scanner itself had bypass CVEs).

facts.claim: Credentials stripped from the env of MCP subprocesses by default; variables explicitly declared are passed through.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Approval hook surfaces include `mcp-trust/<server>` and `mcp-elicitation/<server>`.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D05.rationale: MCP servers only in user/managed config; consent surfaces for MCP trust/elicitation; env scrubbing of MCP subprocesses; per-server tool include/exclude; no repo-level MCP file.

facts.claim: Skills execute arbitrary Python at import time; Skills Guard is a review aid, boundary is operator review.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: CVE-2026-9353: Skills Guard multi-word prompt handling THREAT_PATTERNS bypass (< 0.15.0).
facts.label: third-party-report

D06.rationale: Skills Guard scans skills but is explicitly a review aid; skills and plugins execute arbitrary Python in-process; plugins explicit-enable; catalog exists.

facts.claim: Provider keys and gateway tokens are stripped from env passed to shell/MCP/cron/code-exec children by default.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: CVE-2026-53870: response_store.db and webhook_subscriptions.json created world-readable (0o644); fixed 0.16.0.
facts.label: third-party-report

D07.rationale: Secrets in .env/auth.json (chmod 600 guidance), credential vault 0600, env scrubbing for subprocesses, log redaction, managed secret pins, optional external secret managers; a world-readable-files CVE existed.

facts.claim: approvals.cron_mode, single_query_mode, unattended_mode default `deny`.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Gateway authorization order ends with default: deny.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D08.rationale: Headless paths default to deny: single_query_mode, cron_mode, unattended_mode all deny dangerous commands; gateway authorization is default-deny with DM pairing.

facts.claim: MEMORY.md/USER.md written by the agent via memory tool; frozen snapshot injected at session start; memory.write_approval default false.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: CVE-2026-10223: injection issue in _scan_memory_content (< 0.15.0).
facts.label: third-party-report

D09.rationale: Persistent cross-project agent-writable memory injected into every session; write_approval gate off by default; injection scanning exists but had a CVE.

facts.claim: delegate_task children get isolated context, inherited tool access, own terminal sessions; model cannot pass toolsets.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D10.rationale: Children inherit only the parent's enabled toolsets (cannot be widened by the model) with isolated context and terminals; credential pinning per delegation; no stronger isolation documented.

facts.claim: Logs under ~/.hermes/logs with secrets auto-redacted; pre-approval hooks allow auditing.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D11.rationale: Session store, gateway/error logs with secret redaction, approval-surface hooks for audit; no tamper-evident or enterprise audit log.

facts.claim: No telemetry/analytics opt-out documented in security/configuration docs searched; token analytics are local-only.
facts.label: unverified

D12.rationale: No telemetry feature documented either way (unverified); prompts go to configured provider.

facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: updates.pre_update_backup quick|full|off.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D13.rationale: curl|bash installer plus pip, Docker, Nix, signed Termux APT; pre-update state snapshots; no checksum/signature statement for the main installer found.

facts.claim: Managed scope values win over ~/.hermes/config.yaml, ~/.hermes/.env and the shell environment for exactly the pinned keys; dir 0755 root-owned.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D14.rationale: Managed scope: root-owned /etc/hermes config.yaml and .env pin selected keys above user config and shell env; enforced by filesystem permissions.
